description: IPEDS (Integrated Postsecondary Education Data System) complete data files for US colleges and universities. Data collected annually by NCES from ~6,400 institutions participating in federal student aid programs.

notes.unitid: UNITID is the primary key linking all tables — unique institution identifier
notes.rv_files: _RV suffix files contain revised data (prior year revision)
notes.drv_files: DRV prefix files are 'derived' — pre-computed summary statistics from NCES
notes.sfa_naming: SFA (Student Financial Aid) uses academic year naming (e.g., SFA2223 = 2022-23 academic year, corresponding to the 2023-24 IPEDS collection)

HD2023.csv.description: Institutional Header/Directory — institution name, address, sector, control, Carnegie classification, geographic info

IC2023.csv.description: Institutional Characteristics — programs offered, student services, athletic associations, admissions requirements

adm2023.csv.description: Admissions — applicants, admits, enrollees, test scores by gender

drvadm2023.csv.description: Derived Admissions — pre-computed admissions rates and yield

sfa2223.csv.description: Student Financial Aid (2022-23) — types and amounts of aid, net price by income bracket

gr2023.csv.description: Graduation Rates — 150% time graduation rates by cohort, race/ethnicity, gender

drvgr2023.csv.description: Derived Graduation Rates — pre-computed 4-year, 6-year, 8-year graduation rates

gr200_23.csv.description: 200% Graduation Rates — 200% normal time completion rates

gr2023_pell_ssl.csv.description: Graduation Rates by Pell Grant and Stafford Loan status

C2023_a.csv.description: Completions — degrees/certificates awarded by CIP code, award level, race/ethnicity, gender

ef2023a.csv.description: Fall Enrollment — enrollment by race/ethnicity, gender, attendance status

ef2023b.csv.description: Fall Enrollment — enrollment by age group

ef2023c.csv.description: Fall Enrollment — residence of first-time freshmen

ef2023d.csv.description: Fall Enrollment — total entering class, retention rates

EFFY2023.csv.description: 12-Month Unduplicated Headcount — total unduplicated enrollment by race/ethnicity

drvef2023.csv.description: Derived Enrollment — pre-computed enrollment summaries, FTE

drvic2023.csv.description: Derived Institutional Characteristics — pre-computed tuition/fee summaries

Flags2023.csv.description: Data quality flags and imputation indicators

dictionaries.sfa2223.xlsx: Data dictionary for SFA2223 (Student Financial Aid)
dictionaries.drvgr2023.xlsx: Data dictionary for DRVGR2023 (Derived Graduation Rates)
